# Sentinel-2 RGB Imagery — Product Spec & Usage

**Status:** in production (generated by `scripts/export_s2_composites.py`).
**Audience:** anyone consuming the Sentinel-2 imagery for the pure-S2 RTS model (and
QA). This is the spec/handoff doc the imagery ships with.

This product is the **Sentinel-2 RGB(+NIR) composite imagery** for the *pure-S2 RTS
model* — a model that detects RTS directly on Sentinel-2, used to cover **74–84°N
(ARTS North)** where no PlanetScope basemap exists, and the southern permafrost domain.
It is **separate** from the Planet-model EXTRA channels (the per-tile NDVI etc. that
co-register to PlanetScope tiles — see `data/data.md §9` and `data/extra_channels.py`).
Design rationale and decisions: `docs/s2_extra_data_prep.md`.

---

## 1. What it is

Cloud-masked **July–September median surface-reflectance composites** from
`COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED`, exported per grid cell as GeoTIFFs in **EPSG:3857**.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Source collection | `COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED` (Sentinel-2 L2A, surface reflectance) |
| Compositing | per-scene QA60 cloud+cirrus mask (bits 10/11), `CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE < 20`, **median** over Jul 1 – Sep 30 |
| Values | reflectance, float32 (raw DN ÷ 10000); **no normalization applied on disk** |
| Bands (default) | `B4, B3, B2, B8` = **Red, Green, Blue, NIR** (band order as written) |
| Resolution | **10 m** (S2 native), projected in EPSG:3857 |
| CRS | **EPSG:3857** everywhere (project standard) |
| Nodata | masked outside cell ∩ domain (ocean / out-of-domain) |
| Format | deflate-compressed GeoTIFF (cloud-optimized) |
| Tiling | exported as **1°×3° grid cells** (not 512² tiles); tile to 512² downstream |

**The recipe is the single source of truth** in
[`data/extra_channels.py`](extra_channels.py) (`s2_sr_composite`, plus `S2_COLLECTION`,
`S2_WINDOW`, `S2_CLOUD_PCT`, `S2_BANDS`). The Planet-model EXTRA channels and this RGB
product are built from the *same* composite, so they are mutually consistent
(CLAUDE Rule 3/5). NIR (`B8`) is included so NDVI can be derived identically downstream.

> **North CRS sign-off (doc §6.6):** at 74–84°N, EPSG:3857 carries ~5–6× Web-Mercator
> scale distortion. For the pure-S2 North model this is **deliberately accepted** to keep
> a single pipeline shared with the South (no Planet basemap forces 3857 here, unlike the
> Planet model). Consumers needing low-distortion North analysis should be aware.

---

## 2. Extent (what was downloaded)

Domains are MultiPolygons (`domain/circumpolar_{south,north}_domain.geojson`,
EPSG:3413); the export grid is clipped to them (already land/permafrost-only).

| Job | Year | Region | Extent |
|---|---|---|---|
| training | 2024 | South | ARTS South **label-bearing regions only** (doc §6.1) |
| training | 2024 | North | ARTS North label footprints (re-exported to 3857, §6.3) |
| inference | 2025 | South | **full** `circumpolar_south_domain` (~45–76°N, Planet coverage) |
| inference | 2025 | North | **full** `circumpolar_north_domain` (~74–84°N) |

- **South** = Arctic-boreal ∩ permafrost ∩ ArcticDEM, clipped to Planet coverage (≤~76°N).
- **North** = same intersection above the Planet limit (74–84°N), Sentinel-2 only.

## 3. Storage layout

Bucket: **`gs://rts-mapping-v2-usw1`** (PDG, us-west1 single-region; created 2026-06-24).

```
gs://rts-mapping-v2-usw1/S2_RGB/<job>/<cell_id>*.tif
   2025_south/   full circumpolar_south_domain   (1799 cells)   — inference
   2025_north/   full circumpolar_north_domain   ( 272 cells)   — inference
   2024_train/   domain/train_label_footprint.geojson (1063 cells, N+S label sites buffered 5 km, §6.1) — training
```
(`train_label_footprint.geojson` is a derived artifact — not committed; regenerate with:
`gpd.read_file('domain/train_points.geojson').to_crs(3857).buffer(5000).union_all()` → save as GeoJSON.)
```
```
`cell_id` = SW corner of the 1°×3° cell, `{E|W}<|lon|×10, 4-digit>_{N|S}<|lat|×10, 4-digit>`
(deterministic — the same ground cell always gets the same id, across years/reruns). Large cells are
split by GEE into `<cell_id><offset>-<offset>.tif` sub-tiles (mosaic them or read as a set).

---

## 4. How to use

```python
import rasterio
with rasterio.open("gs://.../S2_RGB/2025_south/W1500_N0740.tif") as ds:
    rgb = ds.read([1, 2, 3])      # R,G,B  (bands written in B4,B3,B2,B8 order)
    nir = ds.read(4)              # NIR
    ndvi = (nir - rgb[0]) / (nir + rgb[0] + 1e-6)
```
- Values are **reflectance (0–1-ish)**, float32. **Normalize per-dataset** with
  `scripts/compute_normalization_stats.py` before training (do *not* reuse the
  Planet-model stats — different sensor/scale).
- Tile to 512×512 EPSG:3857 for the model (see `scripts/positive_tile_creation.py`;
  note the negative-tile path needs a grid-metadata rework — it is Planet-quad-coupled).
- Labels: reuse the current ARTS labels, convention `0=bg, 1=RTS, 255=ignore`
  (`data/data.md §2.4`), co-registered in EPSG:3857.

---

## 5. Regeneration / resume

```bash
python scripts/export_s2_composites.py --year 2025 \
   --domain domain/circumpolar_south_domain.geojson \
   --bucket rts-mapping-v2-usw1 --prefix S2_RGB/2025_south
```
Resumable: cells already present under the prefix are skipped; the launcher backs off when
the GEE task queue is full. Run inside the `rts-train` Docker image (earthengine-api +
ADC). See `docs/s2_extra_data_prep.md §3` for the full run matrix.
